Given an access log file `/var/log/nginx/access.log` with the format:
`192.168.1.10 - - [01/Mar/2026:14:20:10 +0000] "POST /api/v1/checkout HTTP/1.1" 504 1420 "-" "curl/7.68.0"`

$1: Client IP, $4: Timestamp, $6: HTTP Method, $7: Request URI, $9: HTTP Status Code, $10: Response Bytes

Write a robust one-line Bash command pipeline (using awk, sort, uniq, and head) that:
1. Filters for requests with HTTP status code 504;
2. Extracts the top 3 most frequent Request URIs ($7) experiencing 504 errors along with their occurrence count;
3. Formats the output sorted by count descending in the format: `<count> <URI>`.

State the exact command line and explain the purpose of each pipeline component.
